name: Evidence & Diagnosis
description: Clinician evidence retrieval + grounded differential diagnosis. Marketplace-publishable A2A specialist sharing the TrustedRisk MCP backend. Advertises 6 skills: Grounded differential diagnosis, Guideline-grounded treatment selection, PubMed + ClinicalTrials.gov + drug pricing + NIH RePORTER, Chart-intelligence (NER + NegEx + structurer), Conversational SHARP patient resolver, PHI leakage check. FHIR context propagated via the A2A v1 FHIR-context extension; tools see the FHIRContext via the shared ContextVar without ever surfacing the bearer token to the LLM prompt. Every recommendation surfaces a calibrated CI when applicable, a deterministic safety gate, an abstain trigger when uncertainty or demographic bias is high, a 4-critic ensemble vote (clinical_safety + fairness + evidence + llm_judge) with bounded plan revision, a fairness audit by demographic subgroup, and a longitudinal patient timeline that surfaces drift across encounters.

_bundles._doc: Thematic groupings for client-side discovery. Tools may appear in multiple bundles (e.g. ground_claim, fairness_audit). The runtime exposes BUNDLES via the tools package (mcp_server.tools.list_bundles()).

skills.name: Grounded differential diagnosis
skills.description: compute_differential_diagnosis_ranker (LLM-4) takes a presenting complaint + structured chart and re-ranks a deterministic DDx table using an LLM. `Can't-miss` diagnoses surface unconditionally regardless of LLM output; per-item `grounding_verdict` flags hallucinations.
examples: Re-rank a chest-pain DDx for a 65y M with diaphoresis + pain to L arm.
Generate a DDx for confusion in a 90y nursing-home resident.

skills.name: Guideline-grounded treatment selection
skills.description: Given a clinical condition and structured patient factors, rank the candidate treatments and surface contraindications + cautions. Each top pick is grounded against the W3 guideline corpus (FAISS index) so the recommendation comes back with a citable evidence excerpt. Bundled conditions: atrial_fibrillation_anticoagulation (CHA₂DS₂-VASc-driven AC choice), anticoagulation_pre_op_bridging (peri-op LMWH bridging plan), hf_reduced_ef_initial_therapy (4-pillar GDMT selection), dm2_second_line_after_metformin (SGLT2/GLP-1/SU/insulin ranking). Unsupported conditions return abstain_recommended=true.
examples: Rank anticoagulation options for a non-valvular AF patient with CHA₂DS₂-VASc 4 and eGFR 55.
Plan peri-operative anticoagulation bridging for a patient on warfarin with mechanical mitral valve.
Recommend second-line T2D therapy after metformin for a patient with heart failure.

skills.name: PubMed + ClinicalTrials.gov + drug pricing + NIH RePORTER
skills.description: Four KNOWLEDGE-1/2/3/4 tools: compute_pubmed_search (Entrez API), compute_clinical_trials_matcher (CT.gov v2, eligibility-criteria delta), compute_drug_pricing (RxNorm → unit pricing + 30-day estimate), compute_nih_reporter_search (RePORTER v2 grants).
examples: Pull recent PubMed citations on apixaban dosing in AKI.
Match this NSCLC patient to open ClinicalTrials.gov studies.
Drug pricing for a 90-day supply of metformin + lisinopril.

skills.name: Chart-intelligence (NER + NegEx + structurer)
skills.description: Three CHART-1/2/3 tools: compute_clinical_ner (rule-based + dictionary-based NER with CUI), compute_negation_temporal (Chapman 2001 NegEx + temporal scope), compute_structure_discharge_summary (free-text → DecisionCard-shaped artifact). Used to ingest non-FHIR text from legacy EHRs.
examples: Extract clinical entities from a free-text discharge summary.
Resolve negation in `no chest pain` and `history of CHF`.
Structure a free-text admission note into a DecisionCard artifact.

skills.name: Conversational SHARP patient resolver
skills.description: compute_resolve_patient_from_query (LLM-3) takes a free-text reference ("the 78-year-old gentleman from yesterday with chest pain") and resolves it to a SHARP-on-MCP X-Patient-ID against a pre-fetched candidate cohort. Deterministic regex floor for MRN / name / DOB; LLM only re-ranks. Top match set ONLY when score ≥ 0.6 AND margin ≥ 0.2; otherwise abstains and returns ranked candidates.
examples: Resolve `the older gentleman with the chest pain from this morning` to a Patient ID.
Free-text patient lookup with deterministic floor.

skills.name: PHI leakage check
skills.description: Scan arbitrary clinical text for PHI entities and produce a redaction map. Does not require FHIR patient context.
examples: Scan this discharge summary for PHI.
Does this note contain any protected information?

extensions.description: A2A v1 FHIR-context extension. The platform delivers FHIR credentials in `Message.metadata` keyed by this URI, with camelCase fields {fhirUrl, fhirToken, patientId, fhirRefreshToken?, fhirRefreshTokenUrl?}. TrustedRisk consumes the metadata in its before-model hook, populates the shared FHIRContext ContextVar, and never lets the credentials reach the LLM prompt. See https://docs.promptopinion.ai/fhir-context/a2a-fhir-context.html.

selfCritique.description: Every clinical recommendation passes through a 4-critic ensemble (clinical_safety + fairness + evidence + llm_judge) that may downgrade confidence, force abstain, or request a replay before the response is emitted. The LLM critic has a deterministic floor (pass-through approval) so it never blocks unilaterally.

memoryLayer.description: Prior DecisionCards for the same patient are retrieved from a SQLite-backed memory store. When a valid (non-expired, same-model-version) card is found, it can serve directly; otherwise a fresh tool chain runs and detect_recommendation_drift flags any meaningful change vs the prior.

temporalValidity.description: Every RiskEstimate carries a valid_until timestamp scaled by clinical-risk severity (high LACE → 4h, moderate → 12h, low → 24h). Expired cards force a re-call.

fairnessAuditCalibration.description: Subgroup-multiplier baseline is calibrated on the receiving cohort (internal calibration workflow output) and falls back to literature defaults (HRRP/HCUP/JAMA) when the calibrated artifact is absent.

counterfactualExplanation.description: Per-factor what-if sweep shows how each LACE component contributes to the predicted risk and identifies a minimum-modification path that would flip the recommendation tier.

multiTenant.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant (RFC 6749 §4.4) with per-client allowed_fhir_servers allowlist enforces tenant isolation: a token issued for tenant A cannot be used to query tenant B's FHIR endpoint.

auditTrail.description: Append-only HIPAA-style audit log (PHI-redacted SHA-256 hashing) plus an RFC 6962 Merkle audit chain for tamper-evidence; reproducibility archive enables byte-identical replay of any historical decision.

rightToExplanation.description: GDPR Art. 22 / EU AI Act Art. 13 right-to-explanation surface — every DecisionCard is paired with a patient-friendly audit summary on demand.

differentialPrivacyEquity.description: Equity dashboard publishes subgroup intervention / abstain / risk rates with Laplace-mechanism differential privacy.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: Optional bearer-token authentication (RFC 6749 §4.4). Disabled by default; enable via TRUSTEDRISK_OAUTH_ENABLED=1.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Static API-key authentication for marketplace-mediated A2A calls. Configured via TRUSTEDRISK_API_KEYS env var (comma-separated). When set, every A2A call must carry `X-API-Key` matching one of the configured values.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
